title: actaea macrophylla
intro: Actaea macrophylla, commonly known as American ginseng or black cohosh, is a perennial plant native to eastern North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes, due to its health benefits in regulating hormonal balance. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, providing relief from menstrual cramps, anxiety, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Actaea macrophylla include triterpene glycosides, such as actein and 23-epi-26-deoxyactein, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
